title: Use the Inactive Patients report
summary: Patients who haven't come in a while, for win-back campaigns.

steps.title: Menu → Reports → Inactive Patients
steps.details: Patients who haven't come in a while, for win-back campaigns.

steps.title: Filters
steps.details: «No activity for more than» (months) and «Medical discharge only».

steps.title: Results
